      "reasoning":"The issuing-country/IP mismatch and failed address verification support card misuse, strengthened by the failed identity check. The check does not establish the precise fraud mechanism."

      "reasoning":"A legitimate traveller could explain the foreign IP and an address-verification mismatch. The failed identity check substantially weakens that explanation."

  "citations":["R03","FP-2 §6.3","FP-2 §6.4","FP-2 §6.5(a)","FP-2 §6.5(b)","FP-2 §6.6(b)","FP-2 §5.2","FP-2 §5.3(b)","FP-2 §4.2"],
  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds: issuing-country/IP mismatch accompanies failed address verification. Card is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Although travel could explain the geography and address mismatch, the required id_check failed. Under FP-2 §5.3(b), that failure decides the order and requires decline because Linkage is absent; escalation is prohibited. The order remains unshipped. Recommend decline, with no further check needed. This is advisory and sets no queue priority."
